patches.name: ProxMobo License Check Bypass
patches.description: Disables Google's Play app-licensing (PairIP) check so ProxMobo does not show license errors or close when it is not installed/licensed through Google Play.

patches.name: ProxMobo Premium Unlock
patches.description: Reports the lifetime Premium product (proxmobo.premium.lifetime) as purchased so all Premium features are unlocked.
